C1488.title: Ethereum Eclipse Attack Detection Framework
C1488.summary: This study proposes a framework for detecting eclipse attacks on Ethereum. Such attacks control a target node's peer connections, isolating it from the honest network and feeding it attacker-selected information. The paper models adversarial capabilities formally, analyzes Ethereum P2P connection features, and develops a method for identifying node isolation in order to reduce its impact on consensus participation.

references.title: A Robust Eclipse Attack Detection Framework for Ethereum Networks
